title: LLM-Based Financial Sentiment Analysis in Arabic: Evidence from Saudi Markets

live_model.evidence: Appendix A.1: "GPT-4 Turbo: gpt-4-turbo-2024-04-09 (max_tokens = 50)"; Sec 4.2: "three-model consensus labeling strategy (GPT-4 Turbo, GPT-4o Mini, Gemini 2.5 Flash)" used to build the gold-standard sentiment labels.

prompt.location: Appendix B gives the full summarization prompt (for GPT-4o Mini) but the extracted text does not include a separate classification-prompt appendix for the sentiment-labeling task

claim.location: Table 2, row "GPT-4 Turbo* 0.496 0.634 0.496 0.556 0.000"; footnote: "*Models used to construct [the gold standard]"

data.source: 84K-sample Arabic financial sentiment corpus (Sec. 4); "GitHub repository URL will be provided in the camera-ready" (not yet public)

notes: GPT-4 Turbo's Table 2 row is explicitly flagged by the authors' own asterisk as one of the three models used to build the evaluation's own gold-standard labels, i.e. it is graded partly against its own annotations; GPT-4 Turbo, GPT-4o Mini and Gemini 2.5 Flash all report byte-for-byte identical Acc/Prec/Rec/F1/Macro-F1 values (0.496/0.634/0.496/0.556/0.000), which reads as a circularity or reporting artifact rather than an independent capability result. Dataset release is only promised for camera-ready, not yet public.
